parsed.summary: I traced the power tree (barrel jack J12 / USB-C J5 → TPS2121 power mux → AP63203 buck → +3V3), the three MAX31855KASA thermocouple channels (shared SCK/SO with three independent CS lines and 1 µF decoupling), the TPS1H200A heater switch (IN/DIAG_EN both on the GPIO1 net, CL tied to GND, OUT to the heater terminal), the USB-C front end (5.1 kΩ CC pulldowns) and the ESP32-C3 EN/3V3 support circuitry against the specification. Every value, net and pin function that the drawing makes legible (51.1 kΩ ILIM, 10 nF soft-start, 3.9 µH inductor, FB tied to +3V3, EN tied to IN, 10 K EN pull-up, 5.1 kΩ CC resistors) agrees with the intended design, so no deviation is supported by the schematic as drawn.
